header.title: Step 3: Configure Process Settings
header.description: Adjust the settings for data processing and API model selection to optimize the crawling and extraction process.

chunking.title: Chunking Configuration
chunking.description: Chunking helps break large documents into smaller, manageable pieces for more efficient processing and better API performance.
chunking.enableDescription: Select this option to automatically split documents into smaller chunks.
chunking.sizeDescription: Defines the maximum number of text units per chunk. Smaller chunks may increase processing time but improve accuracy.
chunking.delayDescription: Time to wait before automatically sending the next chunk.

apiSelection.title: API Model Selection
apiSelection.description: Select the appropriate AI model for each data extraction and processing API step.
apiSelection.modelTypeHint: Choose between 'Non-Tuned' (general purpose) or 'Tuned' (fine-tuned for specific tasks, if available) models.
apiSelection.cfpTunedUnavailable: Tuned model for CFP is temporarily unavailable

modelDescriptions.nonTuned: A versatile model suitable for general content. Good balance of speed and accuracy.
modelDescriptions.tuned: A highly optimized model fine-tuned for specific patterns, offering superior accuracy for specific tasks.

determineLinks.name: Main Links Identification
determineLinks.purpose: This API analyzes the crawled content to identify and extract primary links, such as those leading to Call for Papers (CFP) and Important Dates (IMP) sections.

extractInfo.name: General Conference Information Extraction
extractInfo.purpose: This API extracts core conference details including key dates (submission, notification, conference dates), location, main topics, and organizers.

extractCfp.name: Call for Papers (CFP) Content Extraction
extractCfp.purpose: This API specializes in extracting the full text and key elements of the Call for Papers, often including a summary of topics, guidelines, and submission procedures.

warning.selectModelsBeforeProceeding: Please select a model for all API steps before proceeding.

output.title: Output Configuration
output.recordFileDescription: If enabled, JSON and CSV file containing the full API responses will be saved for debugging and analysis.
